P0_RAW.description: Original registered Quranic source data files

AG-01.name: APPLY_FLAG_REQUIRED
AG-01.rule: Without --apply, mode MUST be DRY_RUN_ONLY, no filesystem mutation API may execute

AG-02.name: AUTHORIZATION_ID_REQUIRED
AG-02.rule: --apply alone MUST NOT authorize mutation; --authorization-id is also required

AG-03.name: AUTHORIZATION_RECORD_VALIDATION
AG-03.rule: Authorization ID must resolve to a real governance record: exists, APPROVED, type permits Source Vault activation, scope matches, not revoked

AG-04.name: POLICY_HASH_VERIFICATION
AG-04.rule: --expected-policy-hash must match the independently computed actual policy hash

AG-05.name: STRICT_AND_GATE
AG-05.rule: APPLY_FLAG AND VALID_AUTHORIZATION AND POLICY_HASH_MATCH; no OR/fallback may permit mutation

AG-06.name: SCOPE_BINDING
AG-06.rule: Authorization valid for TIRE_SOURCES/** does not automatically authorize D0_OUTPUT/**; both must be explicitly bound

AG-07.name: REALPATH_BOUNDARY
AG-07.rule: Resolve actual real path; validate against approved roots; protect against traversal, symlink escape, junction escape

AG-08.name: PRECONDITION_HASH
AG-08.rule: CURRENT_SHA256 must equal APPROVED_PRE_ACTIVATION_SHA256 for each protected file before mutation

AG-09.name: ACL_STATE_CAPTURE
AG-09.rule: Exact pre-activation ACL/security state must be captured before any ACL mutation; icacls /reset is NOT proof of exact restoration

AG-10.name: FAIL_CLOSED
AG-10.rule: All authorization failures in guards AG-01 through AG-09 result in STOP + NO_MUTATION + structured audit record
